output.summary: KEP-4639 adds a new VolumeSource that mounts OCI images and OCI artifacts as read-only directories inside a pod, so files can be shared among containers without being baked into the main image. The KEP is implemented and at stable stage.
output.rationale: Sharing files between containers currently requires copying them with an init container and a shell, or bundling them into the main image. The KEP scopes the work to directory mounts only, leaves single-file and manifest-list cases out, and leaves runtime-level format handling to the CRI runtimes. Discussion pushed toward kubelet owning the lifecycle with the runtime serving pull and unmount requests, and some reviewers preferred an out-of-tree CSI driver instead.

alternatives.why_not: The readme lists it as an alternative to be documented, and reviewers (kfox1111) noted drivers had poor adoption because clusters did not deploy them. The sources do not record a final rejection rationale beyond the decision to implement in-tree.

alternatives.option: Shared volumes inside a single pod or an init container copying files
alternatives.why_not: The author (sallyom) said this required packaging a shell in the model image and an init container, which the new VolumeSource is meant to remove.

alternatives.option: Extend the CRI PullImage RPC with a target path field
alternatives.why_not: Proposed by haircommander as a way to reduce RPC duplication; mrunalp responded that the kubelet should own lifecycle decisions and the runtime should service requests. The sources do not show it was adopted.

alternatives.option: Single-file mounts or manifest-list handling in the first version
alternatives.why_not: The readme's non-goals and the 2024-06-14 meeting summary explicitly leave single-file and manifest-list cases out for now, restricting output to directories and matching architecture.

evidence.quote: The enhancement leaves single file use case out for now and restrict the mount output to directories.
It will be simpler to leave single file use case out for now and restrict the mount output to directories.
Yes, it would be best let kubelet be responsible for lifecycling decisions and let the runtime service the requests.
Most of the in-tree advantages listed here can be done with an external CSI driver.
In order to remove the need for a shell & init container, I propose a new OCI VolumeSource.
